parsed.rationale: Both `StreamingLinkTapped.init(service:artist:album:)` and `ExternalLinkTapped.init(service:artist:album:)` share an identical parameter signature, but they represent structurally distinct analytics event types — one for streaming-link taps and one for external-link taps — whose coincidental shape reflects the domain (both events naturally capture the same contextual data: service, artist, album). The `structural_evidence` block carries all-null values (no `differing_slots`, no `jaccard`, no `shared_ancestor`, no `shared_field_count`), meaning the pipeline has no field-level evidence to support a meaningful merge. Collapsing these into a shared initializer or a common protocol would conflate two intentionally separate event concepts, harming analytics clarity and downstream event-routing logic. No refactor is warranted.
